for i,v in pairs(game.CoreGui:GetChildren()) do
   if v.Name == "Orion" then

       getgenv().automana = false

       firetouchinterest(HUMRP,game:GetService("Workspace")["_SYSTEM"]["_SERVER"].ManaHitbox.ManaHitboxS,1)              
    end   
end

local areas = {}
for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace")["_SYSTEM"]["_EGG"]:GetChildren()) do
   table.insert(eggs,v.Name)
end    
for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace")["_SYSTEM"]["_AREAs"]:GetChildren()) do
   table.insert(areas,v.Name) 
end

local MainSec = Window:MakeTab({
	Name = "Main",
	Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998",
	PremiumOnly = false
})

	Name = "Credits",
	Icon = "rbxassetid://4483345998",

})
--variables

	Name = "Info",

  	end    
})

})

}

game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.LoadPreferences:FireServer(unpack(args))
	end    
})

	Name = "Anti-afk",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(Value)

game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.Idled:connect(function()

vu:Button2Down(Vector2.new(0,0),workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
wait(1)
vu:Button2Up(Vector2.new(0,0),workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame)
end)
	end    
})

	Name = "Remove Water System",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(Value)
    if Value then
       for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace")["_SYSTEM"]["_WATER"]:GetChildren()) do

        end   
    else
        for i,v in pairs(game:GetService("Workspace")["_SYSTEM"]["_WATER"]:GetChildren()) do
           v.CanTouch = true
        end    
    end 
end    
})
MiscSec:AddToggle({
    Name = "Skip Card Open Anim",
    Default = false,
    Callback = function(Value)
       if Value == true then
          game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Main.Scripts["Card Hatch"].Disabled = true
          else
          game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer.PlayerGui.Main.Scripts["Card Hatch"].Disabled = false
        end   
    end
})

	Default = false,
	Callback = function(Value)
getgenv().automana = Value
spawn(function()
while getgenv().automana == true do
wait()
game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.TappingEvent:FireServer()
end
end)
	end    
}) 

MainSec:AddToggle({
	Name = "Auto Train",
	Default = false,
	Callback = function(Value)
        getgenv().autotrain = Value
        spawn(function()
        while getgenv().autotrain == true do
        HUMRP.CFrame = trainer.CFrame + Vector3.new(0,0,0)
        local args = {
            [1] = "Train",
            [2] = trainer

        game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.ClientRemote:InvokeServer(unpack(args))

        end)
	end    
})

    getgenv().doublemana = Value
    spawn(function()
        while wait() do

firetouchinterest(game.Players.LocalPlayer.Character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart"),game:GetService("Workspace")["_SYSTEM"]["_SERVER"].ManaHitbox.ManaHitboxS,1)            
else

})

    local args = {

        end

	end    
})

        end     
	end    
})

})

    while getgenv().autoopeneggs do
    wait()
